cause: The V66 custody intentionally inherits the exact frozen V62 starter-quality source semantics. Under those frozen semantics the 2022 whiff-quality component is constant, so its raw training standard deviation is zero.

correction.rule: For a finite non-empty training component with raw standard deviation exactly zero, preserve its frozen raw values and training mean, use an effective standardization scale of 1.0, and mark zeroVarianceTraining=true. The standardized contribution is therefore zero rather than an error.
